capabilities.name: Goal mode
availability_conditions: Codex app, CLI, or IDE extension
Goal mode available on the active surface
capabilities.security_boundary: Goal mode can continue for hours or days but remains inside the active Codex sandbox and approval policy; it is not HOTL completion evidence.

capabilities.name: Subagents
availability_conditions: Enabled by default in current Codex releases
Spawned only after an explicit user request
capabilities.security_boundary: Subagents inherit parent sandbox and live approval overrides.

capabilities.name: Local, worktree, and remote thread handoff
availability_conditions: Matching project available on the destination host
Connected and trusted local or remote host
capabilities.security_boundary: Handoff moves host execution context but does not transfer HOTL controller ownership until the new controller explicitly claims or takes over the run.

capabilities.name: Remote connections
availability_conditions: Codex Remote available for the active account
Authenticated paired host and supported mobile or desktop client
capabilities.security_boundary: Remote control uses the connected host's project, credentials, permissions, and approval boundary; remote UI status is not a HOTL receipt.

capabilities.name: Managed worktrees
availability_conditions: Git repository
Codex app or supported local surface
capabilities.security_boundary: Filesystem access remains bounded by the active Codex permissions.

capabilities.name: Lifecycle hooks
availability_conditions: Hooks feature enabled
Non-managed hook definition reviewed and trusted
capabilities.security_boundary: Non-managed command hooks require hash-based user trust before execution.

capabilities.name: Automations
availability_conditions: Codex app
Automation availability for the active account and workspace
capabilities.security_boundary: Automation runs use the configured project permissions and workspace policy.

capabilities.name: Native code review
availability_conditions: Git repository with a reviewable diff, commit, or base branch
capabilities.security_boundary: Review is read-oriented unless the user separately authorizes fixes.

capabilities.name: Memories
availability_conditions: Memories available for the active account
Memory use or generation enabled
capabilities.security_boundary: Memory use follows account, workspace, and per-thread controls.

capabilities.name: Browser Developer mode
availability_conditions: Codex app Browser or Chrome integration
Full CDP access enabled and allowed by workspace policy
capabilities.security_boundary: Full CDP inspection requires explicit approval and can be disabled by managed policy.

capabilities.name: Goal and loop continuation
availability_conditions: Claude Code distribution exposing /goal and /loop
Hooks and managed policy permit the selected continuation path
capabilities.security_boundary: Goal and loop commands continue host turns but do not replace HOTL iteration bounds, gates, ownership, or receipts.

capabilities.name: Background subagents
availability_conditions: Claude Code session with Agent tool availability
Background tasks not disabled by configuration
capabilities.security_boundary: Subagents run in the background by default but their completion notification is not verification or HOTL completion evidence.

capabilities.name: Dynamic workflows
availability_conditions: Paid plan or supported API/provider
Dynamic workflows enabled where required
capabilities.security_boundary: Spawned agents inherit the workflow tool allowlist and use accept-edits behavior for file changes.

capabilities.name: Subagents
availability_conditions: Claude Code session with the Agent tool available
capabilities.security_boundary: Subagent tools, model, permissions, and MCP access are scoped by the agent definition and parent session.

capabilities.name: Agent teams
availability_conditions: Experimental agent teams enabled
Task can be partitioned without conflicting shared-file edits
capabilities.security_boundary: Each teammate is an independent Claude Code session with team coordination tools.

capabilities.name: Agent view
availability_conditions: Agent view available in the active Claude Code distribution
capabilities.security_boundary: Background sessions continue without a terminal and may use isolated worktrees; agent-view row state is scheduling telemetry, not HOTL completion evidence.

capabilities.name: Worktree-isolated sessions
availability_conditions: Git repository
capabilities.security_boundary: Filesystem and command permissions continue to apply inside the isolated checkout.

capabilities.name: Lifecycle hooks
availability_conditions: Hooks not disabled by user or managed settings
capabilities.security_boundary: Hooks execute with the trust level of the local Claude Code process and must be reviewed as code.

capabilities.name: Auto permission mode
availability_conditions: Eligible plan and supported model/provider
Workspace admin enablement when required
capabilities.security_boundary: A classifier reviews actions after hard permission rules; auto mode is not a substitute for sensitive-operation review.

capabilities.name: Plugin background monitors
availability_conditions: Interactive CLI with Monitor tool availability
Plugin enabled
capabilities.security_boundary: Monitors run unsandboxed at hook trust level and require careful command review.

capabilities.name: HOTL workflow execution
availability_conditions: HOTL runtime or inline executor available
capabilities.security_boundary: Uses the active host's shell sandbox and approval boundary while HOTL enforces controller ownership, workflow order, retry limits, aggregate budgets, gates, and effect evidence.

capabilities.name: HOTL worktree isolation
availability_conditions: Git repository with at least one commit
capabilities.security_boundary: Protected branches, dirty worktrees, and branch collisions stop according to HOTL preflight rules.

capabilities.name: Durable run state
availability_conditions: jq installed
capabilities.security_boundary: Serialized, revisioned state remains local under the execution root and is gitignored by default; explicit leased controller ownership prevents concurrent mutation and age alone never permits takeover.

capabilities.name: Typed verification
availability_conditions: HOTL runtime available
Required verifier capability available or human fallback accepted
capabilities.security_boundary: Verification commands run inside the active host shell boundary.

capabilities.name: Risk-sensitive human gates
availability_conditions: Interactive controller available for human gates
capabilities.security_boundary: High-risk human gates cannot be auto-approved.

capabilities.name: Durable execution reporting
availability_conditions: jq installed for state-managed reporting
capabilities.security_boundary: Reports default to concise successful output and captured failure evidence; missing reports are reconstructed from authoritative state and completion remains false until disposition is recorded.
